input.quote: 22.1 Vendor may audit Customer's compliance with licence quantities no more than once in any twelve-month period, on at least thirty days' prior written notice, during normal business hours, and in a manner that does not unreasonably disrupt Customer. An audit will be conducted off-site where practicable by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality.
input.rationale: § 22 is the only audit right binding us and it meets the preferred position on every material term: frequency capped at once per twelve months, thirty days' prior written notice, normal business hours, off-site where practicable via an independent auditor bound by confidentiality, Vendor bears cost unless underpayment exceeds five percent, and no direct access to Customer systems, unrelated Customer Data, privileged material or third-party confidential information (p0095). § 22.3 additionally treats findings as our Confidential Information and limits their use. § 23 (Records and Customer Assurance) contains no counterparty audit right, and no other inspection, verification or remote-monitoring language binding us exists in the document. No redline needed.
